2.t: when the blind man came to him––

3.t: for all you know, he might have grown in spirit,

4.t: or taken note of something useful to him.

6.t: you go out of your way––

7.t: though you are not to be blamed for his lack of spiritual growth––

8.t: but from the one who has come to you full of eagerness

10.t: you allow yourself to be distracted.

11.t: No indeed! This [Quran] is a lesson

12.t: from which those who wish to be taught should learn,

17.t: Woe to man! How ungrateful he is!

18.t: From what thing does God create him?

19.t: He creates him from a droplet, He proportions him,

20.t: He makes the way easy for him,

21.t: then He causes him to die and be buried.

22.t: When He wills, He will raise him up again.

23.t: Yet man does not fulfil God’s commands.

24.t: Let man consider the food he eats!

26.t: and cause the soil to split open.

32.t: all for you and your livestock to enjoy.

34.t: the Day man will flee from his own brother,

37.t: each of them will be absorbed in concerns of their own on that Day-

38.t: on that Day some faces will be beaming,

40.t: but some faces will be dust-stained

42.t: those are the disbelievers, the licentious.
